steps.name: Meet Marsiyah at the pavilion
steps.hint: Ruru is waiting in the courtyard. Approach Marsiyah and press E.

steps.name: Write your name in the Stone Guestbook
steps.hint: The blue stone beside the courtyard records the names of passing couriers.

steps.name: Collect the borrowed satchel and bread
steps.hint: Check the satchel's stitching and the package on the supply table before leaving.

steps.name: Read the sign toward the tower
steps.hint: Follow the stone path north. Press M to open the region map.

steps.name: Deliver the bread to Jumel
steps.hint: Use the stone footholds on the slope. Jumel waits at the foot of the tower.

steps.name: Examine the satchel drawing in Jumel's grandfather's journal
steps.hint: The journal lies open on the bench near Jumel. Examine the source of his story.

steps.name: Return and report your meeting with Jumel
steps.hint: Return to the post. Your Glider Cape helps you descend to lower ground.

steps.name: Inspect the footbridge at the ravine's edge
steps.hint: Follow the lanterns west. The footbridge still connects both sides of the ravine.

steps.name: Carry the entrusted song to Bu Lamit
steps.hint: Walk across the footbridge. Describe the shell's condition when you hand it over.

steps.name: Listen to and inspect the Main Well
steps.hint: Bu Lamit asked you to record changes in the sound from the well near the hall.

steps.name: Report on Telaga Sumi
steps.hint: Bring Marsiyah news of the song and the well.

steps.name: Count and wrap the sister post's supplies
steps.hint: Two bundles of supplies and one travel permit. Record their initial condition at the supply table.

steps.name: Read the eastern gate's inspection notice
steps.hint: Follow the eastern road. Check why it is closed before speaking to the guard.

steps.name: Request permission to continue the delivery
steps.hint: Show Kesa your travel permit. The delivery destination is beyond the gate.

steps.name: Recover the remaining cargo and inspection receipt
steps.hint: The inspection table is beside the gate. Check what you can still take home.

steps.name: Report the partial delivery failure to Marsiyah
steps.hint: Bring the remaining supplies and detention receipt back to the post.

steps.name: Compare the warning signs in the inspection book
steps.hint: Marsiyah placed inspection record 009 on the kitchen table. Compare it with the news from the well.

steps.name: Hear Marsiyah's mandate and accept the letter
steps.hint: All warning signs are present. Marsiyah is ready to pass on a trust kept for four generations.

steps.name: Record the bearer and witness names on the seal
steps.hint: At the stamping table, speak your name with Marsiyah. The letter remains sealed.

steps.name: Confirm the inspection instructions before leaving
steps.hint: Confirm how to use plate 009 and where to go after the inspection.

steps.name: Meet Kesa at the closed gate
steps.hint: Kesa has seen what happened to your cargo. Explain your inspection mandate.

steps.name: Check your supplies at the storm-route shelter
steps.hint: Choose Jalur Lentera or Tebing Utara on the map. Stop at the shelter marker on your route.

steps.name: Observe lantern 009's pulses
steps.hint: At the foot of the tower, inspect the lantern without touching the Architect Ring.

steps.name: Compare the cracked ring with the test diagram
steps.hint: Inspect the marker ring beside the plate. Both warning signs are required.

steps.name: Press the back of the letter against plate 009
steps.hint: Keep the letter sealed. Use the side bearing the Asharim seal.

steps.name: Follow Ruru to the test building behind the tower
steps.hint: A different sound comes from the small building. Inspect its door cover.

steps.name: Listen to the residual sound in the test stone
steps.hint: The sound comes from inside the building, separate from plate 009.

steps.name: Compare the trace with the inspection record
steps.hint: Inspect the plate beside the stone. Separate proven facts from what remains unknown.

steps.name: Enter Dusun Sela and meet Nenek Ima with Ruru
steps.hint: Follow the eastern ridge to Dusun Sela's gate to begin Chapter 1 with Nenek Ima and Orsuk.

steps.name: Return to Nenek Ima's veranda
steps.hint: Follow the stone road into Dusun Sela. Ima's house faces the palm garden on the village's eastern side.

steps.name: Deliver Ima's provisions to Jumel
steps.hint: Retrace the ridge to the Menara Senja courtyard.

steps.name: Collect a copy of the Stone Guestbook
steps.hint: Descend the tower road to Pos Nilasar. Guest records must retain a clear source.

steps.name: Carry the records to Balai Cawan
steps.hint: Cross the footbridge and head to the northern veranda of Telaga Sumi.

steps.name: Check the merchant's claims
steps.hint: Compare the seal and price records at the next table. State your doubts without changing the message.

steps.name: Meet Orsuk at Dusun Sela's gate
steps.hint: Return via Pos Nilasar and Menara Senja to Dusun Sela. Earth-red cloth marks the Balkut caravan.

steps.name: Deliver the goods to the Balkut caravan
steps.hint: Follow the cloth banners north across the savanna to Padang Salkara. Check the cargo beside the trail before the council circle.

steps.name: Listen to the Seven Banners Council
steps.hint: Seven banners gather around one fire in Padang Salkara. Hear why they are withholding their decision.

steps.name: Carry a promise to return with evidence
steps.hint: Record the promise west of the fire circle. The Cirusian seal awaits verifiable testimony.

READ_LEDGER.text: The satchel drawing in Jumel's grandfather's journal matches the borrowed satchel's stitching. Sahdan's story was passed down through records; Jumel did not witness the Silent Day.

DELIVER_SHELL_A.text: Bu Lamit recognized Tiwano's entrusted song, including its off-key final note. I stayed to listen with her.

DELIVER_SHELL_B.text: Tiwano's entrusted song reached Bu Lamit. I asked for directions to the well after handing it over.

INSPECT_WELL.text: The Main Well repeats fragments of old voices. Bu Lamit says they are growing louder. Their source and cause remain unknown.

READ_TOLL_NOTICE.text: The Council notice closes the eastern crossing because of disturbances. Inspection orders are also holding up deliveries between posts.

DETAIN_RECEIPT.text: One of two supply bundles was detained. I asked Kesa to record the amount and reason before recovering the rest.

DETAIN_PROTECT.text: One of two supply bundles was detained. I protected the returned bundle first; Kesa included an inspection receipt.

RECOVER_CARGO.text: I brought home one remaining supply bundle and the inspection receipt. The sister post has not received its delivery.

REPORT_DIRECT.text: I reported the detention and the remaining cargo's condition directly. Marsiyah recorded a partial failure and accepted the remaining supplies.

REPORT_HESITANT.text: I admitted my fear of disappointing Marsiyah, then honestly explained the detention and damage. She accepted my report and the remaining supplies.

CHECK_WARNINGS.text: Marsiyah's inspection notes describe three untuned pulses and a cracked ring at 009. News from the Main Well strengthens the case for further inspection.

STAMP_LETTER.text: The Asharim Witness Seal records Nara as bearer and Marsiyah as witness. Their names were spoken over the echo-ink pad. The letter remains sealed.

OPEN_NORTH_PATH.text: Kesa unlocked Tebing Utara. The official gate remains closed. Jalur Lentera offers a more sheltered detour.

OBSERVE_PULSES.text: Lantern 009 pulsed three times without anyone tuning its ring.

INSPECT_RING.text: The cracked marker ring matches the outer instructions' diagram. Both warning signs at 009 have been inspected firsthand.

CONTACT_LETTER.text: Pressing the letter's back to the plate triggered a brief reflection that spoke Nara's name. The name is stored in the seal's ink. The letter remains sealed; the public network has not awakened.

HEAR_TEST_TRACE.text: The stone in the test building repeats a warning about seven Dim Relay Tower branches and incomplete tuning. This trace does not answer questions or speak my name.

COMPARE_RECORD.text: The year 58 plate matches the year heard in the test stone. The architect's identity and the Council branches' present condition remain unknown.

FINISH_CHAPTER.text: Chapter 0's inspection is complete, and Chapter 1 begins in Dusun Sela. Nenek Ima revealed inherited Lulanai Bronze Ear Covers, and Orsuk invited me to Padang Salkara.

HEAR_IMA.text: Ima's parents' Bronze Ear Covers dampen Noise. The family concealed its Lulanai origins because of persecution, not because Nara was chosen.

DELIVER_IMA.text: Ima's provisions reached Jumel in the Menara Senja courtyard.

TAKE_REGISTER.text: The Stone Guestbook copy travels with its source and destination recorded. Guest records do not grant permission to open every delivery.

DELIVER_REGISTER.text: The exchange of water, salt, and news sustains the routes. Trade Posts give the Council copies of guest records for reduced dues.

QUESTION_PRICE.text: Nara passed on the cargo without changing the message, while noting that the price claim lacked a comparison.

PASS_PRICE.text: Nara passed on the price claim unchanged. Its source is recorded; its truth remains unverified.

JOIN_BALKUT.text: Orsuk connected Nara with the Balkut Banner's overland caravan.

DELIVER_CARAVAN.text: Bahtari blue pepper, Asharim salt, and Tseren paper sustain the caravan together.

HEAR_COUNCIL.text: The Old and Young Banners remain divided. The Kadum Banner withholds its vote pending evidence; the Cirusian seal has not been granted.

KEEP_PROMISE.text: Nara earned the right to return with evidence to the Seven Banners Council. The Salkara Edge Stone investigation continues in Chapter 2.
